title: One truth, many shapes.
hook: One business truth. A website, an answer, a post. Same facts.
thesis: The FYD object graph is one tenant truth, and from it the system compiles a website section, a concierge answer, and a social post, each faithful to the same underlying facts. That optionality is the moat: new channels arrive without changing the canonical model. This post shows the same fact wearing three shapes in about 30 seconds.

verified: One tenant truth compiles into a website (SiteSpec), Ask FYD, and campaign specs; channels expand without changing the canonical model (FYD ten-day directive, via SYSTEMS.md section 2).

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
